insiders.methodology:
Recipients of DUST Sablier vesting streams on Monad created by Neverland's
    stream sender wallet, attributed by withdrawal destination. Staking tracks net DUST
    transferred to the veDUST contract.

Ecosystem Incentives.methodology: Tracks DUST incentives distributed through Neverland's DustRewardsController and Merkl campaigns on Monad.

dust-rewards-controller.name: DUST Incentives
dust-rewards-controller.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from Neverland's DustRewardsController, filtered to DUST rewards. These rewards go to protocol users.

merkl-campaigns.name: Merkl Campaigns
merkl-campaigns.methodology: Tracks NewCampaign events from Merkl DistributionCreator for DUST and amortizes each campaign evenly over its duration.

Ecosystem Incentives (TBD).methodology: Remaining ecosystem incentives allocation after observed DustRewardsController claims and Merkl campaigns.

remaining-ecosystem-incentives.name: Ecosystem Incentives (TBD)
remaining-ecosystem-incentives.methodology: 40% of DUST supply allocated to ecosystem incentives, minus observed DustRewardsController claims and Merkl campaign amounts.
